Lots of CRs are sent out during the final days of meeting based on late agreements, due to lack of time for careful check, many typos and errors are introduced to the specification, which also increase the burden of maintaining the specifications. Observation 1: following issues are identified for current CR approach: No sufficient time for CR drafting since some controversial issues are settled on Friday No sufficient review time for CRs during the final days based on late agreements To solve the issue, running CR approach as in RAN1/2 can be considered for CR handling. As for responsibilities sharing, big CR editor, section editor, WI rapporteurs can be considered. In detail, WI rapporteurs is responsible for the changes of each WI. For the sections which are updated by different WIs, section editor is responsible for merging the changes from different WI into the same section. Spec editor is responsible for merging the changes from different sections into the spec.
